Pentone Architecture & Reliability Standards

Pentone provides deterministic browser automation with local-first on-device intelligence. All browser mutations require explicit voice authorization tokens minted through local speaker verification.

Security invariance: Internal Chrome pages, dangerous URL schemes, and unauthorized destructive mutations are rejected fail-closed at the background gateway before execution.
